LanguageData.LP_Path_Fighter.label: fighter
LanguageData.LP_Path_Fighter.description: Martial techniques of the DND fighter. Melee branch: Second Wind, War Cry, Charge, Trip Attack, Action Surge, Weapon Specialization, Indomitable, Disarming Strike, Whirlwind Attack, Guardian Stance, and ultimately Renewed Fighting Spirit; Shooting branch (1.53.0): Steady Aim, Suppressing Fire, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, and ultimately Eye of Death. Either Melee or Shooting 6 unlocks the path; the Melee branch uses "martial power", the Shooting branch "marksman power", and Second Wind and War Cry use the higher of the two. Each tier requires the matching skill level of that branch (6/9/12/15/18). Martial path: regain psyfocus by fighting (grit), Extra Attack, fighting style.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Fighter.lockedReason: Requires Melee or Shooting 6 (or adventurer Strength/Dexterity 13)
LanguageData.LP_Path_Fighter.tooltip: Fighter: the Melee branch uses Melee, the Shooting branch uses Shooting.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Wizard.label: wizard
LanguageData.LP_Path_Wizard.description: The arcane magic of the DND wizard: Magic Missile, Mage Armor, Fireball, Sleep, Lightning Bolt, Haste, Wall of Stone, Teleport and Disintegrate. Spell power uses "arcane power" (grows with Intellectual level); damage is also multiplied by psychic sensitivity (minimum 0.2, no cap), with high psyfocus and neural heat costs. Each tier of spells requires the matching Intellectual level (6/9/12/15/18).
LanguageData.LP_Path_Wizard.tooltip: Wizard: Intellectual sets arcane power and learnable spells.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Cleric.label: cleric
LanguageData.LP_Path_Cleric.description: The divine magic of the DND cleric: Cure Wounds, Bless, Lesser Restoration, Guidance, Divine Strike, Turn Undead, Mass Cure Wounds, Death Ward and Revivify. Divine power uses "divine power" (grows with Social level); damage and healing are also multiplied by psychic sensitivity (minimum 0.2, no cap). Each tier of divine spells requires the matching Social level (6/9/12/15/18).
LanguageData.LP_Path_Cleric.tooltip: Cleric: Social sets divine power and learnable divine spells.
